description: This file defines the Returns controller class within the OpenCart admin module, handling the sale return management functionalities including listing, filtering, editing, creating, deleting, and managing return history.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class managing sale return operations including listing, editing, creating, deleting, and viewing return histories within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the list of returns with filters, breadcrumbs, and page setup.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests or direct calls to list returns, returning the HTML for the returns list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of returns based on filters, sorting, and pagination for display.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a return, populating data if editing an existing return.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to create or update a return, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected returns after permission validation.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history (comments and status changes) for a specific return.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the history entries for a specific return.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new status/comment entry to the return's history with permission validation.
